Sandwich Loaf
Ingredients
Bread flour: 500g (4 cups) — 100%
Water: 325g (1 1/3 cups) — 65%
Salt: 10g (1 3/4 tsp) — 2%
Instant yeast: 7g (2 1/4 tsp) — 1.4%
Butter: 30g (2 tbsp) — 6%
Method
Mix everything to a smooth dough and knead for 8 minutes.
Prove until doubled, shape into a pan loaf, and prove again.
Bake at 400F for 35 minutes.
Serves 12. Prep 3 hours. Cook 35 mins.
